record.source: -1 atlases; 0..15 prior target; 64..79 immutable image slot

alpha: existing straight-sRGB primitives premultiplied by shader; targets premultiplied RGBA8, source-over One/OneMinusSrcAlpha into non-sRGB targets; image texels premultiply before interpolation
ownership: caller retains plan, vertices, atlas and canonical CPU image bytes; SDK reserves all objects before encoding; no feedback or prefix submission; slot generations retained until GPU completion; source images replay on device recreation
coordinate_space: local y-down viewport at each isolated layer; affine applied to completed layer; outer clips at parent composite, child clips before transform; clip before source/backdrop capture; full viewport retains in-viewport blur halo
blur: transparent border, normalized bounded separable Gaussian radius <=32; backdrop copies already-painted parent then blurs before sharp children
contract: new profile; no changes to AFP1 or the legacy flat vertex/entry-point contract
